[[Decade Scythe "Funeral Fang"]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[scythe]] obtained from [[Ancient Anniversary Weaponsmith]] in [[Embark Beach]] during the [[Anniversary Celebration]] in exchange for 5 [[Proof of Legend|Proofs of Legend]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage|Slashing Dmg]]: 9-41 (Requires 9 [[Scythe Mastery]])
:Deals 20% additional [[damage]] during [[Special event|Festival events]]. No effect in [[PvP]].
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
:[[Enchantment]]s last 20% longer
:Crafted in tribute to an enduring legend.

==Skin==
Uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Ancient Scythe (common)]] [[dye]]d black.

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated, as the "+20% damage during Festival Events" mod does not exist outside the unique Decade weapons.

==Notes==
[[File:Decade_Scythe_Funeral_Fang_Swing.jpg|150px|right]]
*This scythe leaves behind a black trail of particles with each [[auto attack]] when the wielder is not under the effects of a [[form]] or [[tonic]].
*The inherent bonus damage during events is only active during certain events ([[Canthan New Year]], [[Anniversary Celebration]], [[Dragon Festival]], [[Wayfarer's Reverie]], [[Halloween]], and [[Wintersday]]).
{{anomaly|Unlike [[Decade Rod "All the World"]], [[Decade Rod "Antipode Alloy"]], [[Decade Rod "Undying Service"]], [[Decade Staff "Astral Pillar"]], [[Decade Staff "Underworld Pillar"]] and all non-Decade [[weapon]]s, this scythe's appearance is not changed when the wielder is under the effects of a [[weapon spell]].}}

==Trivia==
*Introduced in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20150422|April 22, 2015 update]].
